Marked with a `//`-comment key because this file is JSON and carries NO <!-- methodology:start owner=... --> regions: those markers are markdown-only, and boundary_headers.py governs CLAUDE.md (_REQUIRED_GOVERNED), not .vscode. //repo-personal-sort: explorer.sortOrderReverse gives newest-first inside dated folders (docs/audits/, docs/handoffs/, docs/decisions/transcripts/) whose names are YYYY-MM-DD-slug. It is duplicated from .dev-knowledge.code-workspace:63 ON PURPOSE: that file loads ONLY when the project is opened as a WORKSPACE, so in folder-mode the preference vanished and dated folders fell back to the VS Code default (ascending = oldest-first). Both sources now agree on newest-first; explorer.sortOrder is deliberately left UNSET here (VS Code default is `default`, which is what the workspace file sets explicitly) so the two cannot disagree.
//boundary: Background decoration of the #312 Form-A methodology boundary. owner=hub regions paint GREY, owner=repo regions paint NAVY, tuned for a dark theme. The regions are keyed on the MARKER vocabulary (<!-- methodology:start id=... owner=hub|repo -->), which is the single source of truth -- the reader-visible headers these bands also cover are GENERATED from the same markers by scripts/boundary_headers.py.
